capabilities: Rate concepts on a five-button scale that writes confidence and last_reviewed frontmatter
Rank which concepts to study next from unrated, weak, and stale notes
Run timed study sprints that end with a recall prompt
Award XP, levels, streaks, and badges for study actions
Suggest unlinked concept references and convert Better BibTeX citekeys to Zotero links
extras: Personal plugin, not yet in the community catalogue; install via BRAT or by copying files manually. Requires vault notes using a specific frontmatter schema (type: concept / type: source) or the dashboard stays empty. No network, account, or telemetry; English or Swedish interface.
motivation: The author built it because most study gamification has a failure mode: "rate everything 5, feel great, learn nothing"; this design pays the same XP for any rating and rewards downgrades.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track which concepts need studying, and gamified study tools typically reward inflated self-ratings instead of study work.
